ai_rules: Commands must delegate all business logic to core modules; no logic in command files
All user inputs must be validated/sanitized via @inquirer/prompts validation or core validation utilities
Environment configuration must use dotenv with strict typing via a centralized config interface
All TypeScript code must include 100% test coverage using @oclif/test, mocha, and chai with test files colocated in the same directory as implementation files
Code formatting must conform to Prettier and ESLint rules defined in @oclif/prettier-config and eslint-config-oclif
ESLint configurations must extend @eslint/compat to ensure compatibility across different ESLint versions
